title: Override signature mismatch

sourceOfTruth.rule: Decompile the base type and match the current method signature exactly.

symptoms: No suitable method found to override.
Return type, parameter type, parameter count, nullability, or method name changed in Core.
investigation: Identify the overridden method and declaring base type.
Decompile the installed package for the base type.
Check whether the method was renamed, removed, or changed signature.
Compare return type, parameter types, generic arguments, nullability, and access modifier.
patchRules: Change only the override signature to match the decompiled base method.
Preserve the existing client method body wherever possible.
Update call sites only if the method contract changed and the build requires it.
antiPatterns: Never blindly change override to new.
Do not copy the Core base method body into the client override.
Do not rewrite business logic while adapting the signature.

successCriteria: Existing client override behavior is preserved except for required signature adaptation.
